units.transition: fixed capture-time claim across two requests

R00.name: Valid exact JSON
R00.definition: One JSON object satisfying the frozen four-key schema.

R10.name: Unrecoverable JSON
R10.definition: No recoverable JSON object; excludes valid JSON with the wrong schema.

R11.name: Schema violation
R11.definition: Recoverable JSON, but wrong type, keys, values, IDs or duplicate citation IDs.

R12.name: Extra output around JSON
R12.definition: A valid schema object can be extracted, but the complete response is not that JSON object.

R20.name: Missing result
R20.definition: No saved step. Not a semantic model error.

R21.name: Infrastructure failure
R21.definition: Saved step reports a non-ok execution status. Not a semantic model error.

S00.name: Correct known value
S00.definition: Expected yes/no and the output matches.

S01.name: Correct abstention before evidence
S01.definition: Target packet not received; expected and output are unknown.

S02.name: Correct abstention on unsettled evidence
S02.definition: Target packet received, provisional label remains unknown, output unknown.

S10.name: Commitment before target evidence
S10.definition: Output yes/no while target packet has not been received.

S11.name: Commitment on unsettled evidence
S11.definition: Output yes/no after the target packet arrived, although its provisional label remains unknown.

S12.name: Abstention on a provisionally known state
S12.definition: Output unknown where the frozen label is yes/no. Does not establish a perception failure.

S13.name: Opposite binary value
S13.definition: Expected yes/no, output is the other binary value. Does not identify the internal cause.

E00.name: Requested packet named
E00.definition: Exactly the received packet for the requested capture time. Does not verify visual support or the state value.

E01.name: Empty citation permitted
E01.definition: No citation and no known-state support requirement: unseen target or an unresolved label.

E10.name: Required citation missing
E10.definition: Known expected value and received target packet, but an empty evidence list. Independent of value correctness.

E11.name: Wrong received capture-time packet
E11.definition: All references received, but list is not exactly the requested packet; includes both A and B.

E12.name: Unreceived packet named
E12.definition: At least one reference not received; takes precedence over wrong-time citation.

K00.name: Same answer
K00.definition: Both fields target the same predicate and capture time and have equal values; may still both be wrong.

K10.name: Binary contradiction
K10.definition: Same claim gets opposing yes/no answers.

K11.name: Certainty disagreement
K11.definition: Same claim gets unknown in one field and yes/no in the other. Not a yes/no contradiction.

T00.name: Correct new-evidence value update
T00.definition: Expected unknown becomes known, prior output correctly unknown, final output matches the new label. No grounding claim.

T01.name: Correct value maintained
T01.definition: Expected value unchanged and both outputs match; includes justified unknown remaining unknown.

T02.name: Recovery after an incorrect prior
T02.definition: Expected value unchanged; incorrect prior becomes correct. Does not prove retrieval of earlier visual evidence.

T10.name: Missed resolution after evidence
T10.definition: Expected unknown becomes known, correctly unknown prior stays unknown.

T11.name: Wrong resolution after evidence
T11.definition: Expected unknown becomes known, correctly unknown prior resolves to the wrong binary value.

T12.name: Appropriate uncertainty lost
T12.definition: Expected unknown unchanged; prior correctly unknown becomes binary.

T13.name: Known value withdrawn
T13.definition: Expected yes/no unchanged; initially correct value becomes unknown.

T14.name: Known value inverted
T14.definition: Expected yes/no unchanged; initially correct value becomes the other binary value.

T15.name: Prior error not repaired
T15.definition: Expected value unchanged; both prior and final outputs wrong. Excludes loss of a correct prior.

T16.name: Update starts from an incorrect prior
T16.definition: Expected value changes but the prior was already wrong; not a clean update trial. Final correctness is retained separately.

primary_claim_partition.unit: one capture-time claim per request, collapsing aliased fields
primary_claim_partition.precedence: If aliased fields disagree, assign K10/K11 only. Otherwise assign one S code for the shared value. Citation and transition facets are not added to this partition.

curated_task_blockers.unit: ungraded task, assigned from reviewed source/task findings
curated_task_blockers.D01: Target identity or occurrence specification requires clarification.
curated_task_blockers.D04: Specified target and intended positive evidence window do not align.
curated_task_blockers.precedence: Resolve target meaning before asserting a task/window mismatch; not inferred from model outputs.

overlap_policy: One code per eligible unit within each partition. Never sum different partitions. A case can contain many distinct observations.
